description: Interrupciones de Acueducto - Aguas Nacionales EPM is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Aguas Nacionales EPM S.A. E.S.P., Antioquia. Estos datos corresponden a las interrupciones que ha realizado Aguas Nacionales EPM S.A. E.S.P. empezando la segunda semana de Agosto del año 2020. Cuenta con información acerca del motivo, la duración y localización exacta de los sectores involucrados. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Aguas Nacionales EPM S.A. E.S.P., Antioquia. Its tags are interrupciones, sectores, quibdó, servicios públicos, interrupciones de acueducto. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Función pública. The portal shows 2024-05-02 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
